verdict.rationale: Codex's CLI docs say users can choose the model for a task, and community reports show switching between OpenAI models such as gpt-5.3-codex and gpt-5.3-codex-spark inside Codex CLI. Nothing in the evidence shows models from providers other than OpenAI; community mentions of moving to Claude or Gemini describe users leaving Codex for other tools, not an in-product option. Missing for 10: documented support for non-OpenAI model providers, a configuration guide for provider and model selection, a list of available models.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose which underlying AI model powers my session from multiple providers

citations.quote: Stay in control: Choose the model, reasoning effort, permissions, and commands that fit the task.
First thoughts using gpt-5.3-codex-spark in Codex CLI
